phenotype.definition: Severe headaches or migraines (MPQ090 = yes) AND at least one of: dizziness or balance problems in the past year (BAQ020A or BAQ020B = yes; a 'no' to the gate question BAQ010 counts as no), any reported hearing trouble (AUQ130 = a little trouble, a lot of trouble, or deaf), or ears ringing, roaring or buzzing in the past year (AUQ190 = yes). Adults aged 40 and over; complete cases only. This is the proposal §7.1 phenotype narrowed to what NHANES 1999-2004 can express: no sinonasal arm and no recalcitrance (utilization) arm.

eligibility.reason: The Balance questionnaire (BAQ) was administered to respondents aged 40 and over; the pain and audiometry questionnaire items used were asked of ages 20 and over, so adults 40+ are the population with every phenotype item. Verified in the data: BAQ010 is answered by ages 40-85 only.

questionText.headache_migraine: File label: "Severe headaches or migraines" (Miscellaneous Pain questionnaire, MPQ090; asked of ages 20+; 1 = yes, 2 = no).
questionText.dizziness_balance: File labels: "Dizziness problems in past year" (BAQ020A) and "Balance problems in past year" (BAQ020B), Balance questionnaire, ages 40+; either = yes counts. Falling problems alone (BAQ020C) do not count.
questionText.hearing_difficulty: File label: "General condition of hearing" (Audiometry questionnaire, AUQ130). Codes 2, 3 and 4 (a little trouble / a lot of trouble / deaf, per the NHANES AUQ code frame) count as difficulty; 1 = good. Code frame to be re-verified against the codebook by the clinical lead.
questionText.tinnitus: File label: "Ears ringing, roaring, buzzing past year" (Audiometry questionnaire, AUQ190; asked of ages 20+; 1 = yes, 2 = no).

caveats: Screening-level phenotype prevalence, not diagnosed prevalence. No vestibular-testing or ICHD/Barany reference standard exists in these data.
Self-reported survey items; coding inconsistency may bias phenotype capture.
Hypothesis-generating estimate, not a diagnostic count.
Respondents coded Refused / Not Ascertained / Don't Know on a phenotype item are excluded from the denominator, never counted as negative.
Complete-case phenotype: a respondent missing any item the rule uses is excluded from the denominator.

Estimated within the eligible subpopulation only (RIDAGEYR >= 40): The Balance questionnaire (BAQ) was administered to respondents aged 40 and over; the pain and audiometry questionnaire items used were asked of ages 20 and over, so adults 40+ are the population with every phenotype item. Verified in the data: BAQ010 is answered by ages 40-85 only.
Concepts this cycle could not express: sinus_condition, recalcitrance_proxy. The phenotype reported here is narrower than the one defined in proposal 7.1.
No gender-identity item in this cycle: estimates are stratified by sex only. Gender is not substituted from sex.
